generator: targeted XDS literal-recovery pass. Two rules in the compiled spec resolved against the golden samples while being wrong, and both are invisible to a resolution-rate metric: the ebRIM metadata attribute NAME an HIS must write into rim:ExternalIdentifier/rim:Name, and the literal value of rim:Association/@associationType. Every literal and every quote below was read out of spec-source/golden/SOAP/**.xml or spec-source/pages/17694743.json by script; nothing was retyped or recalled.
closes: gate-report.json byElementKind.xdsAssociationType (12 found / 0 resolved, because all three compiled fixedValue rows carried a null `value`) and byElementKind.xdsExternalIdentifierName (59 found / 59 'normalised', 0 exact, because the compiled spec stored only the bare attribute label).

method.task1: Every <rim:ExternalIdentifier> in the 19 official SOAP messages was parsed with its @identificationScheme and its child rim:Name/rim:LocalizedString/@value. Each scheme UUID carries exactly ONE name literal across every sample, so the mapping is unambiguous. The literal is attached as a fixed value on the rim:Name element under the ExternalIdentifier, NOT as a rename of the attribute: the bare label (patientId, uniqueId, sourceId) stays the display label because that is what the NPHIES metadata-optionality pages call it.
method.task2: The associationType table on page 17694743 was re-extracted cell by cell (its 'Meaning | Association Type' rows), and every <rim:Association> in the samples was scanned for @associationType. Page and wire agree on RPLC and disagree on HasMember. BOTH HasMember literals are carried as separate fixedValue rows with their own provenance and a shared conflict id; neither is auto-corrected.
method.provenance: source.sample + a verbatim XML fragment where a sample is the only evidence; source.pageId + the verbatim table-row text where Confluence states it. An entry with source.sample and no pageId is a rule that is NOT in the published spec. Quotes from page 17694743 join a row's cells with ' | ', the same convention spec-build/patch-xds-ebrim.json already uses for that page; no stored quote from any earlier pass is rewritten.
method.whatWasNotDone: No associationType literal was invented from recall. The IHE XFRM and APND forms are listed under `associationTypesNotStated` with the reason they are excluded, and are NOT compiled into fixedValues.

openQuestions.question: Does the nphies registry require rim:Association/@associationType to be the full ebXML RegRep URN urn:oasis:names:tc:ebxml-regrep:AssociationType:HasMember, as page 17694743 states, or the bare token "HasMember", as all 11 official ITI-41 messages emit?

openQuestions.question: Page 17694743 names an "APPD" association in prose but omits any append literal from its SHALL-list of associationType values. Is an append association supported, and if so is the literal urn:ihe:iti:2007:AssociationType:APND?
openQuestions.why: No sample exercises one, so the workbench neither emits nor accepts an append association. The page contradicts itself and only NPHIES can settle it.
